function v_u_4.UpdateThirdPersonFollowTransform(p93, p94, _, _, p95, p96) -- name: UpdateThirdPersonFollowTransform

		p93.needsReset = false

		p93:ResetZoom()
		p93:StartFadeFromBlack()

		local v100 = p93:GetSubjectCFrame()
		if not v100 then
			return v97.CFrame, v97.Focus
		end

		return v101, v99
	end

	local v104 = p93.controlModule

	end

		return nil, nil
	end

function v_u_2.OnThrottleAccel(p22, _, p23, _) -- name: OnThrottleAccel
	if p23 == Enum.UserInputState.End or p23 == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		p22.acceleration = 0
	else
		p22.acceleration = -1
	end
	p22.throttle = p22.acceleration + p22.decceleration
end
function v_u_2.OnThrottleDeccel(p24, _, p25, _) -- name: OnThrottleDeccel
	if p25 == Enum.UserInputState.End or p25 == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		p24.decceleration = 0
	else
		p24.decceleration = 1
	end
	p24.throttle = p24.acceleration + p24.decceleration
end
function v_u_2.OnSteerRight(p26, _, p27, _) -- name: OnSteerRight
	if p27 == Enum.UserInputState.End or p27 == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		p26.turningRight = 0
	else
		p26.turningRight = 1
	end
	p26.steer = p26.turningRight + p26.turningLeft
end
function v_u_2.OnSteerLeft(p28, _, p29, _) -- name: OnSteerLeft
	if p29 == Enum.UserInputState.End or p29 == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		p28.turningLeft = 0
	else
		p28.turningLeft = -1
	end
	p28.steer = p28.turningRight + p28.turningLeft
end
function v_u_2.Update(p30, p31, p32, _) -- name: Update
	if not p30.vehicleSeat then
		return p31, false
	end
	if not p32 then
		local v33 = p30.vehicleSeat.Occupant.RootPart.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(p31)
		p30.vehicleSeat.ThrottleFloat = p30:ComputeThrottle(v33)
		p30.vehicleSeat.SteerFloat = p30:ComputeSteer(v33)
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), true
	end
	local v34 = p30.steer
	local v35 = p30.throttle
	local v36 = p31 + Vector3.new(v34, 0, v35)
	p30.vehicleSeat.ThrottleFloat = -v36.Z
	p30.vehicleSeat.SteerFloat = v36.X
	return v36, true
end
function v_u_2.ComputeThrottle(_, p37) -- name: ComputeThrottle
	return p37 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) and 0 or -p37.Z
end
function v_u_2.ComputeSteer(p38, p39) -- name: ComputeSteer
	if p39 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
		return 0
	end
	local v40 = -p39.x
	local v41 = -p39.z
	return -math.atan2(v40, v41) * 57.29577951308232 / p38.autoPilot.MaxSteeringAngle
end
function v_u_2.SetupAutoPilot(p42) -- name: SetupAutoPilot
	p42.autoPilot.MaxSpeed = p42.vehicleSeat.MaxSpeed
	p42.autoPilot.MaxSteeringAngle = 35
end
return v_u_2

	function v_u_124.OnRenderStepped(_, p152) -- name: OnRenderStepped
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_124, (ref) v_u_20

	end
	function v_u_124.IsCurrentWaypointReached(_) -- name: IsCurrentWaypointReached
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_124
		local v153
		if v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
			v153 = true
		else
			local v154 = v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal:Dot(v_u_124.CurrentHumanoidPosition) - v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneDistance
			local v155 = 0.0625 * -v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal:Dot(v_u_124.CurrentHumanoidVelocity)
			v153 = v154 < math.max(1, v155)
		end

			v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPosition = nil
			v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneDistance = 0

	end
	function v_u_124.OnPointReached(_, p156) -- name: OnPointReached
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_124
		if p156 and not v_u_124.Cancelled then
			if v_u_124.setPointFunc then
				v_u_124.setPointFunc(v_u_124.CurrentPoint)
			end
			local v157 = v_u_124.CurrentPoint + 1
			if #v_u_124.pointList < v157 then
				if v_u_124.stopTraverseFunc then
					v_u_124.stopTraverseFunc()

				v_u_124.Finished:Fire()
				v_u_124:Cleanup()

				local v158 = v_u_124.pointList[v_u_124.CurrentPoint]
				local v159 = v_u_124.pointList[v157]
				local v160 = v_u_124.Humanoid:GetState()

						local v163 = v158.Position - v162.Position
						local v164 = v159.Position - v158.Position
						v161 = Vector2.new(v163.x, v163.z).Unit:Dot(Vector2.new(v164.x, v164.z).Unit) < 0.996
					end

	end

		v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal = p165.Position - p166.Position

	end

			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
		p54.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_17.OnHeartbeat(p61, p62) -- name: OnHeartbeat
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_14
	local v63 = p61.moveVector
	local v64 = p61:GetLocalHumanoid()
	if v64 and v64.Torso then
		if p61.moving and p61.currentPoints then
			local v65 = v64.Torso.Position
			local v66 = (currentPoints[1] - v65) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			local v67 = v66.magnitude
			local v68 = v66 / v67
			if v67 < 1 then
				local v69 = currentPoints[1]
				local v70 = 0
				for v71, v72 in pairs(currentPoints) do
					if v71 ~= 1 then
						v70 = v70 + (v72 - v69).magnitude / v64.WalkSpeed
						v69 = v72
					end
				end
				table.remove(currentPoints, 1)
				currentPointIdx = currentPointIdx + 1
				if #currentPoints == 0 then
					p61:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					return
				end
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(currentPoints)
					v_u_10.renderPath()
				end
				expectedTimeToNextPoint = (currentPoints[1] - v65).magnitude / v64.WalkSpeed
				timeReachedLastPoint = tick()
			else
				if v_u_13 then
					v_u_12.FilterDescendantsInstances = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v73 = workspace:Raycast(v65 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v68 * 3, v_u_12)
					if v73 then
						local v74 = workspace:Raycast(v73.Position + v68 * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(-0, -100, -0), v_u_12).Position.Y - v65.Y
						if v74 < 6 and v74 > -2 then
							v64.Jump = true
						end
					end
				else
					local v75 = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v76 = Ray.new(v65 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v68 * 3)
					local v77, v78, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v76, v75)
					if v77 then
						local v79 = Ray.new(v78 + v68 * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(-0, -100, -0))
						local _, v80, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v79, v75)
						local v81 = v80.Y - v65.Y
						if v81 < 6 and v81 > -2 then
							v64.Jump = true
						end
					end
				end
				if tick() - timeReachedLastPoint > expectedTimeToNextPoint + 2 then
					p61:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					v_u_14:Fire("offtrack")
				end
				v63 = p61.moveVector:Lerp(v68, p62 * 10)
			end
		end
		local v82 = v63.x
		local v83
		if v82 == v82 and v82 ~= (1 / 0) then
			v83 = v82 ~= (-1 / 0)
		else
			v83 = false
		end
		if v83 then
			local v84 = v63.y
			if v84 == v84 and v84 ~= (1 / 0) then
				v83 = v84 ~= (-1 / 0)
			else
				v83 = false
			end
			if v83 then
				local v85 = v63.z
				if v85 == v85 and v85 ~= (1 / 0) then
					v83 = v85 ~= (-1 / 0)
				else
					v83 = false
				end
			end
		end
		if v83 then
			p61.moveVector = v63
		end
	end
end
function v_u_17.OnUserCFrameEnabled(p86) -- name: OnUserCFrameEnabled
	if p86:ShouldUseNavigationLaser() then
		p86:BindJumpAction(false)
		p86:SetLaserPointerMode("Navigation")
	else
		p86:BindJumpAction(true)
		p86:SetLaserPointerMode("Hidden")
	end
end
function v_u_17.Enable(p_u_87, p88) -- name: Enable
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	p_u_87.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	p_u_87.isJumping = false
	if p88 then
		p_u_87.navigationRequestedConn = v_u_1.NavigationRequested:Connect(function(p89, p90)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_87
			p_u_87:OnNavigationRequest(p89, p90)
		end)
		p_u_87.heartbeatConn = v_u_3.Heartbeat:Connect(function(p91)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_87
			p_u_87:OnHeartbeat(p91)
		end)
		v_u_6:BindAction("MoveThumbstick", function(p92, p93, p94)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_87
			return p_u_87:ControlCharacterGamepad(p92, p93, p94)
		end, false, p_u_87.CONTROL_ACTION_PRIORITY, Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1)
		v_u_6:BindActivate(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2)
		p_u_87.userCFrameEnabledConn = v_u_1.UserCFrameEnabled:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_87
			p_u_87:OnUserCFrameEnabled()
		end)
		p_u_87:OnUserCFrameEnabled()
		v_u_1:SetTouchpadMode(Enum.VRTouchpad.Left, Enum.VRTouchpadMode.VirtualThumbstick)
		v_u_1:SetTouchpadMode(Enum.VRTouchpad.Right, Enum.VRTouchpadMode.ABXY)
		p_u_87.enabled = true
	else
		p_u_87:StopFollowingPath()
		v_u_6:UnbindAction("MoveThumbstick")
		v_u_6:UnbindActivate(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2)
		p_u_87:BindJumpAction(false)
		p_u_87:SetLaserPointerMode("Disabled")
		if p_u_87.navigationRequestedConn then
			p_u_87.navigationRequestedConn:Disconnect()
			p_u_87.navigationRequestedConn = nil
		end
		if p_u_87.heartbeatConn then
			p_u_87.heartbeatConn:Disconnect()
			p_u_87.heartbeatConn = nil
		end
		if p_u_87.userCFrameEnabledConn then
			p_u_87.userCFrameEnabledConn:Disconnect()
			p_u_87.userCFrameEnabledConn = nil
		end
		p_u_87.enabled = false
	end
end
return v_u_17

function v_u_15.DustBreak(_, p75, p76, p77, p78, p79, p80, p81) -- name: DustBreak
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_3
	local v82 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	if v_u_14(v82.X - p75.X) + v_u_14(v82.Y - p75.Y) + v_u_14(v82.Z - p75.Z) > 200 then
		return
	elseif _G.Settings.DesPHY then

		for _ = 1, p78 do
			local v84 = (v83 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.random(0, 3.141592653589793)) * CFrame.new(math.random(0, p77 * 10) / 10, 0, 0)).Position

			if v85 then
				local v_u_86 = v_u_8.Damage.DebreeRef:Clone()

				v_u_86.Transparency = v85.Instance.Transparency

				local v88 = math.random(p79 * 10, p80 * 10) / 10
				local v89 = math.random(p79 * 10, p80 * 10) / 10

function v_u_15.DustTrail(_, p96, p97, p_u_98) -- name: DustTrail
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2
	local v99 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	local v100 = p96.PrimaryPart.Position
	if v_u_14(v99.X - v100.X) + v_u_14(v99.Y - v100.Y) + v_u_14(v99.Z - v100.Z) > 200 then
		return
	else
		local v_u_101 = p96.HumanoidRootPart
		if v_u_101 then
			local v_u_102 = v_u_8.Misc.SmokeTrail:Clone()
			v_u_102.Parent = workspace.Effects
			v_u_102.CFrame = v_u_101.CFrame * (p_u_98 or CFrame.new())
			v_u_3:AddItem(v_u_102, p97 + 0.6)
			if p_u_98 then
				v_u_102.Dash.Smoke.Enabled = true
				v_u_4:Create(v_u_102.Dash.Smoke, TweenInfo.new(p97), {
					["Rate"] = 0
				}):Play()
				local v103 = workspace
				local v104 = v_u_101.Position
				local v105 = -v_u_101.Size.Y * 1.6
				local v106 = v103:Raycast(v104, Vector3.new(0, v105, 0), _G.MapParams)
				if v106 then
					v_u_102.Position = v106.Position
					v_u_102.Dash.Smoke:Emit(15)
				end
			end
			local v_u_107 = nil
			local v_u_112 = v_u_2.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_101, (copy) p_u_98, (copy) v_u_102, (ref) v_u_107
				local v108 = workspace
				local v109 = v_u_101.Position
				local v110 = -v_u_101.Size.Y * 1.6
				local v111 = v108:Raycast(v109, Vector3.new(0, v110, 0), _G.MapParams)
				if v111 then
					if p_u_98 then
						v_u_102.Dash.Smoke.Enabled = true
					end
					v_u_102.CFrame = v_u_101.CFrame * (p_u_98 or CFrame.new()) - v_u_101.Position + v111.Position
					v_u_102.Velocity = v_u_101.Velocity

						v_u_107 = v_u_102.Smoke
						v_u_107.Color = ColorSequence.new(v111.Instance.Color)
						v_u_107.Enabled = true
						return
					end
					if v_u_107.Color.Keypoints[1].Value ~= v111.Instance.Color then
						v_u_107.Enabled = false
						v_u_107 = v_u_107:Clone()
						v_u_107.Color = ColorSequence.new(v111.Instance.Color)
						v_u_107.Enabled = true
						v_u_107.Parent = v_u_102

					end

					v_u_102.Dash.Smoke.Enabled = false
					if v_u_107 then
						v_u_107.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end)
			task.delay(p97, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_112, (ref) v_u_107, (copy) v_u_102
				v_u_112:Disconnect()
				if v_u_107 then
					v_u_107.Enabled = false
				end
				v_u_102.Dash.Smoke.Enabled = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

function v_u_15.ApplyCopyOutfit(_, p129, p130) -- name: ApplyCopyOutfit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	p130:ScaleTo(p129:GetScale())
	local v131 = {
		"Head",
		"Left Arm",
		"Left Leg",
		"Right Arm",
		"Right Leg",
		"Torso"
	}
	for _, v132 in p129:GetChildren() do
		if v132:IsA("Shirt") or (v132:IsA("TShirt") or (v132:IsA("Pants") or v132:IsA("BodyColors"))) then
			v132:Clone().Parent = p130
		elseif v132:IsA("Accessory") then
			local v133 = v132:Clone()
			v133.Parent = p130
			local v134 = v133:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld", true)
			v134.Part1 = p130:FindFirstChild(v134.Part1.Name)
		elseif v132:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
			v132:Clone().Parent = p130
		end
	end
	if p129.Head:FindFirstChild("Mesh") then
		p130.Head.Mesh:Destroy()
		p129.Head.Mesh:Clone().Parent = p130.Head
	end
	p130:ScaleTo(1)
	local v135 = p129.Head:FindFirstChild("face")
	if v135 then
		p130.Head.face.Texture = v135.Texture
	end
	if p129:FindFirstChild("Outfit") then
		local v136 = v_u_8.Megumi.Mahoraga.Mahoraga.Outfit:Clone()
		v136.Head.Beard:Destroy()
		v136.Head.Hat:Destroy()
		v136:ScaleTo(0.6666666666666666)
		for _, v137 in v136:GetDescendants() do
			if v137:IsA("Weld") or v137:IsA("Motor6D") then
				if table.find(v131, v137.Part0.Name) then
					v137.Part0 = p130:FindFirstChild(v137.Part0.Name)
				end
				if table.find(v131, v137.Part1.Name) then
					v137.Part1 = p130:FindFirstChild(v137.Part1.Name)
				end
			end
		end
		v136.Parent = p130
	end
	if p130["Left Arm"]:FindFirstChild("FingersL") then
		for _, v138 in p130["Left Arm"].FingersL:GetChildren() do
			if v138:IsA("BasePart") then
				v138.Color = p129["Left Arm"].Color
			end
		end
		for _, v139 in p130["Right Arm"].FingersR:GetChildren() do
			if v139:IsA("BasePart") then
				v139.Color = p129["Right Arm"].Color
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_15.ColorSeqLerpVec(_, p_u_178, p_u_179, p_u_180, p181) -- name: ColorSeqLerpVec
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v_u_182 = p181 or 1
	local function v_u_198(p183, p184) -- name: evalColorSequence
		if p184 == 0 then

			local v186 = p183.Keypoints[#p183.Keypoints].Value.G
			local v187 = p183.Keypoints[#p183.Keypoints].Value.B

		end
		if p184 == 1 then

			local v189 = p183.Keypoints[#p183.Keypoints].Value.G
			local v190 = p183.Keypoints[#p183.Keypoints].Value.B

		end
	end

	v_u_200 = v_u_2.PreRender:Connect(function(_)

function v_u_23.GetTarget(p48, _) -- name: GetTarget
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_29
	local v49 = v_u_6.Character
	if v49 then
		local v50 = nil
		local v51 = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local v52 = v51.ViewportSize.Y / 5
		local v53
		if p48.LastInput == "Mobile" then
			v53 = v_u_6.PlayerGui.Controls.Crosshair.AbsolutePosition
		else
			v53 = Vector2.new(v_u_29.X, v_u_29.Y)
		end
		local v54 = v49:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Chaos" and 1000 or (v49:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Haruta" and 350 or (v49:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Mechamaru" and 300 or (v49:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Chara" and 60 or (v49:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Hanami" and 300 or 100))))
		local v55 = next
		local v56, v57 = workspace.Characters:GetChildren()
		for _, v58 in v55, v56, v57 do
			local v59 = v58:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if v59 then
				v59 = v58:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			end
			if (not v58:GetAttribute("HitboxNPC") or v58.Owner.Value ~= v49) and (v58.Name ~= "HarutaSwordNPC" and (v58 ~= v_u_6.Character and (v59 and v54 >= (v51.CFrame.Position - v59.Position).Magnitude))) then
				local v60, v61 = v51:WorldToScreenPoint(v59.Position)
				local v62 = (Vector2.new(v60.X, v60.Y) - Vector2.new(v53.X, v53.Y)).Magnitude
				if v61 and v62 < v52 then
					v50 = v58
					v52 = v62
				end
			end
		end
		return v50
	end
end
function v_u_23.GetTargetOrProjectile(p63) -- name: GetTargetOrProjectile
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_31
	if v_u_6.Character then
		local v64 = nil
		local v65 = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local v66 = v65.ViewportSize.Y / 5
		local v67
		if p63.LastInput == "Mobile" then
			v67 = v_u_6.PlayerGui.Controls.Crosshair.AbsolutePosition
		else
			v67 = Vector2.new(v_u_29.X, v_u_29.Y)
		end
		local v68 = {}
		for _, v69 in workspace.Characters:GetChildren() do
			local v70 = v69:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if v70 then
				v70 = v69:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			end
			if v69 ~= v_u_6.Character and v70 then
				table.insert(v68, v70)
			end
		end
		if workspace.Map.Destructible:FindFirstChild("Throwable") then
			for _, v71 in workspace.Map.Destructible.Throwable:GetChildren() do
				local v72 = v71.PrimaryPart
				if v72 and not v72:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld") then
					table.insert(v68, v72)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, v73 in v_u_31:GetTagged("CanBoogieWoogie") do
			local v74 = v73.PrimaryPart
			table.insert(v68, v74)
		end
		for _, v75 in v68 do
			if (v65.CFrame.Position - v75.Position).Magnitude <= 100 then
				local v76, v77 = v65:WorldToScreenPoint(v75.Position)
				local v78 = (Vector2.new(v76.X, v76.Y) - Vector2.new(v67.X, v67.Y)).Magnitude
				if v77 and v78 < v66 then
					v64 = v75
					v66 = v78
				end
			end
		end
		if v64 then
			v64 = v64.Parent
		end

function v_u_23.UseSetService(p82, p83, ...) -- name: UseSetService
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_26
	local v84 = v_u_6.Character
	if v84 then
		if p83 == "Ultimate" then
			if v84:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") and v84.CustomChar:GetAttribute("CustomUltData") then
				v_u_1.GetService("CustomService").Awaken:Fire(v_u_26.Custom())
				return
			end
			if v84:GetAttribute("Enchain") then
				local v85 = p82:GetToolService("ItadoriService")
				if v85 then
					v85.UltimateEnchain:Fire(...)
				end
				return
			end
		end
		local v86 = p82:GetToolService(v84:GetAttribute("Moveset") .. "Service")
		if v86 and v86[p83] then
			v86[p83]:Fire(...)
		end
	end
end

				return v89
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_23.UseTool(p90, p_u_91, p92) -- name: UseTool
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_1
	local v_u_93 = v_u_6.Character
	if v_u_93 then
		local v94 = p90:GetToolService(p_u_91:GetAttribute("Service"))
		if v94 and v94[p92] then
			local v95 = v_u_93.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
			if v95 then
				v95 = not workspace:Raycast(v_u_93.PrimaryPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * -(v_u_20:GetCharacterHeight(v_u_93) + 1), _G.MapParams)
			end
			local v_u_96 = v_u_24[p_u_91.Name] == 1 and v95 or (v_u_24[p_u_91.Name] == 2 and p90:GetTarget() or v_u_24[p_u_91.Name] == 3 and v_u_23:GetMouseTarget(75) or (v_u_24[p_u_91.Name] == 4 and require(v_u_6.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule):GetMoveVector() or (v_u_24[p_u_91.Name] == 5 and {
				v95,
				p90:GetTarget(),
				v_u_23:GetMouseTarget(75),
				require(v_u_6.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule):GetMoveVector()
			} or false)))
			if p92 == "Activated" then
				local v97 = v94[p92]
				local v98 = not v_u_96 and v_u_26[p_u_91.Name]
				if v98 then
					v98 = v_u_26[p_u_91.Name]()
				end
				v97:Fire(p_u_91, v98)
			elseif p92 == "Deactivated" then
				pcall(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_91, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_96, (copy) v_u_93
					local v99 = p_u_91:GetAttribute("Service")
					local v100 = #p_u_91:GetAttribute("Service") - 7
					local v101 = string.sub(v99, 0, v100)
					local v102 = v_u_1.GetController(v101 .. "Controller")
					if v102 and v102.ToolDeactivate then
						v_u_96 = v102.ToolDeactivate(v_u_93)
					end
				end)
				v94[p92]:Fire(p_u_91, v_u_96)
			end
		end
	end
end

local v_u_108 = false
local function v_u_117(p109) -- name: ThrowableFire
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16
	if not p109.Info:FindFirstChild("NoThrowable") then
		local v110 = p109.HumanoidRootPart
		local v111 = 4 * p109:GetScale()
		local v112 = nil
		local v113 = v110.Position + v110.CFrame.LookVector * 3
		if workspace.Map.Destructible:FindFirstChild("Throwable") then
			for _, v114 in workspace.Map.Destructible.Throwable:GetChildren() do
				if v114.PrimaryPart and not (v114:GetAttribute("B") or v114:GetAttribute("Hold")) then
					local v115 = (v113 - v114.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude
					if v111 >= v115 then
						v112 = v114
						v111 = v115
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local v116 = p109.Info:FindFirstChild("Throwable")
		if v112 and not v116 then
			v_u_16.Throwable:Fire(v112)
			return true
		end
		if v116 and (v116.Value and not v116.Value:GetAttribute("Stored")) then
			v_u_16.Throwable:Fire(v116.Value)
			return true
		end
	end
end
function v_u_23.Melee(p118) -- name: Melee
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_117, (copy) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_108, (ref) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_23
	local v119 = v_u_6.Character
	if not v119 then
		return
	end
	if _G.Crow and _G.Crow:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Effects.Crows) then
		_G.Crow:FireServer(true)
		return
	end
	_G.Crow = nil
	if v119.Info:FindFirstChild("Emote") then
		v_u_17.EmoteEnd:Fire()
	end
	if v_u_117(v119) then
		return
	end
	if _G.Settings.AutoUse == false and v_u_28.Value then
		v_u_108 = true
		local v120 = v_u_28.Value:GetAttribute("Key")
		p118:UseKey(v120, "Activated")
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until not v119.Parent or v_u_108 == false
		p118:UseKey(v120, "Deactivated")
		return
	end
	v_u_108 = true
	while true do
		local v121 = v119.Info:FindFirstChild("Item")
		if v121 and v121:FindFirstChild("M1") then
			local v122 = v119.Humanoid.Jump == true
			local v123 = v119.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
			v_u_18.M1:Fire(v123 and "Down" or v122 and "Up", p118:GetTarget())
		else
			local v124 = v119.Humanoid.Jump == true
			local v125 = v119.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
			local v126
			if v119:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Hanami" then
				v126 = v124 and "Up" or v125 and "Down"
			else
				v126 = v125 and "Down" or v124 and "Up"
			end
			if v119.Info:FindFirstChild("DomainClash") then
				p118:GetToolService("DomainService").Activated:Fire(v126)
			elseif v119:FindFirstChild("CustomM1") then
				p118:GetToolService("CustomService").Melee:Fire(v_u_26.Custom())
			else
				p118:UseSetService("Activated", v126, v_u_23:GetTarget())
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.025)
		if not v119.Parent or v_u_108 == false then
			return
		end
	end
end
function v_u_23.Special(p127) -- name: Special
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_26
	local v128 = v_u_6.Character
	if v128 then
		local v129
		if v128 and v128:FindFirstChild("Info") then
			v129 = v128.Info:FindFirstChild("Item") or nil
		else
			v129 = nil
		end
		if v129 and v129:FindFirstChild("M2") then
			v_u_18.M2:Fire()
			return
		elseif v128:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") and v128.CustomChar:GetAttribute("CustomSpecial") then
			p127:GetToolService("CustomService").Special:Fire(v_u_26.Custom())
			return
		else
			local v130 = v128:GetAttribute("Moveset")
			if v130 == "Todo" then
				p127:UseSetService("RightActivated", p127:GetTargetOrProjectile())
				return
			elseif v130 == "Naoya" then
				p127:UseSetService("RightActivated", p127:GetMouseTarget(75), p127:GetTarget())
				return
			elseif v130 == "MeiMei" then
				p127:UseSetService("RightActivated", require(v_u_6.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule):GetMoveVector())
			else
				p127:UseSetService("RightActivated", p127:GetTarget())
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

local v_u_114 = 2
function v13.DashRequest(p115) -- name: DashRequest
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_114
	local v116 = v_u_6.Character
	if v116 then
		local v117 = v116.HumanoidRootPart
		local v118 = v116.Humanoid
		if v117 and v118 then
			local v119 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
			local v120 = CFrame.new
			local v121 = v117.Position
			local v122 = v117.Position
			local v123 = v119.X
			local v124 = v119.Z
			local v125 = v120(v121, v122 + Vector3.new(v123, 0, v124))
			local v126 = v118.MoveDirection:Dot(v125.LookVector)
			local v127 = math.round(v126)
			local v128 = v118.MoveDirection:Dot(v125.RightVector)
			local v129 = math.round(v128)
			local v130 = v127 == 1 and "Front" or (v127 == -1 and "Back" or (v129 == 1 and "Right" or (v129 == -1 and "Left" or "Front")))
			if v116.Info:FindFirstChild("Knockback") or v116:GetAttribute("Burst") and not v116.Info:GetAttribute("Burst") or v116.Info:FindFirstChild("ForceEsc") and v116.Info.ForceEsc.Value then
				v_u_23.Dash:Fire(v130, true)
				return
			else
				local v131 = v116:FindFirstChild("CustomChar")
				if v131 then
					v131 = v116.CustomChar:GetAttribute("CustomChase")
				end
				if not v131 or v130 ~= "Front" then
					if v116.Info:FindFirstChild("Block") then
						return
					end
					if v116.Info:FindFirstChild("Stun") then
						return
					end
					if v116:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") > 0 then
						return
					end
					local v132 = v116.Info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
					if v132 and v132.Value == false then
						return
					end
				end
				if v116.Info:FindFirstChild("NoDash") then
					return
				else
					local v133 = false
					if v116.Info:FindFirstChild("DisableChase") then
						local v134 = v_u_24:GetTarget(200)
						if v134 and (v134:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") <= 0 and not v134:GetAttribute("Stun")) then
							local v135 = (v117.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
							local v136 = (v134.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
							local v137 = (v134.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
							v133 = v135:Dot(v136) > -0.2 and v135:Dot(v137) > 0.2 and true or v133
						end
					end
					if v130 == "Front" and (v116:GetAttribute("Moveset") ~= "Naoya" and not (v116.Info:FindFirstChild("DomainClash") or v133)) then
						if tick() - v_u_14 < 0.4 and not v131 then
							return
						else
							local v138 = v116.Info:FindFirstChild("Item")
							if v138 and v138:FindFirstChild("Dash") then
								v_u_26.Dash:Fire()
								return
							elseif v131 then
								v_u_24:GetToolService("CustomService").Chase:Fire(v_u_24.ExtraData.Custom())
							else
								v_u_24:UseSetService("Chase", v118.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air)
							end
						end
					else
						local v139 = v116.Info:FindFirstChild("NoSprint")
						if v139 and v139.Value == false then
							return
						elseif v116:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Naoya" or (v116.Info:FindFirstChild("DomainClash") or v133) then
							if tick() - v_u_14 < 0.3 then
								return
							else
								if tick() - v_u_14 > (v116.Info:FindFirstChild("DomainClash") and 1 or 2) then
									v_u_114 = 2
								end
								if v_u_114 > 0 then
									if not v133 then
										v_u_114 = v_u_114 - 1
									end
									v_u_23.Dash:Fire(v130)
									p115:Dash(v_u_6, v116, v130)
								end
							end
						elseif tick() - v_u_14 >= 2 then
							v_u_23.Dash:Fire(v130)
							p115:Dash(v_u_6, v116, v130)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_1.OnLocalPlayerCameraPropertyChanged(p69, p70) -- name: OnLocalPlayerCameraPropertyChanged
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	if p70 == "CameraMode" then
		if v_u_4.LocalPlayer.CameraMode ~= Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
			if v_u_4.LocalPlayer.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.Classic then
				p69:ActivateCameraController()
			else
				warn("Unhandled value for property player.CameraMode: ", v_u_4.LocalPlayer.CameraMode)
			end
		end
		if not p69.activeCameraController or p69.activeCameraController:GetModuleName() ~= "ClassicCamera" then
			p69:ActivateCameraController()
		end
		if p69.activeCameraController then
			p69.activeCameraController:UpdateForDistancePropertyChange()
			return
		end
	else
		if p70 == "DevComputerCameraMode" or p70 == "DevTouchCameraMode" then
			p69:ActivateCameraController()
			return
		end
		if p70 == "DevCameraOcclusionMode" then
			p69:ActivateOcclusionModule(v_u_4.LocalPlayer.DevCameraOcclusionMode)
			return
		end
		if p70 == "CameraMinZoomDistance" or p70 == "CameraMaxZoomDistance" then
			if p69.activeCameraController then
				p69.activeCameraController:UpdateForDistancePropertyChange()
				return
			end

function v_u_4.UpdateImmersionCamera(p34, p35, _, _, _, p36) -- name: UpdateImmersionCamera

function v_u_4.UpdateThirdPersonComfortTransform(p68, p69, p70, p71, p72, p73) -- name: UpdateThirdPersonComfortTransform
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v74 = p68:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
	local v75 = v74 < 0.5 and 0.5 or v74
	if p72 ~= nil and p68.lastCameraFocus ~= nil then
		local _ = v_u_1.LocalPlayer

		end

		local v81 = p68:getRotation(p69)
		if math.abs(v81) > 0 then

		end

function v_u_4.UpdateThirdPersonFollowTransform(p93, p94, _, _, p95, p96) -- name: UpdateThirdPersonFollowTransform

		p93.needsReset = false

			return v97.CFrame, v97.Focus
		end

	local v102 = v99:ToWorldSpace(p93.focusOffset)

	local v104 = p93.controlModule
	local v105 = v104:GetMoveVector()

		local v106 = v104:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame()

		v102 = v99 * CFrame.Angles(0, -v114, 0) * v115

	local v40 = p39.currentSubjectDistance
	local v41 = v_u_9.getZoomDelta()
	if math.abs(v41) > 0 then
		local v42
		if v41 > 0 then
			local v43 = v40 + v41 * (v40 * 0.5 + 1)
			local v44 = p39.FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD
			v42 = math.max(v43, v44)
		else
			local v45 = (v40 + v41) / (1 - v41 * 0.5)
			v42 = math.max(v45, 0.5)
		end
		p39:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(v42 < p39.FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD and 0.5 or v42)

function v_u_1.calculateRawMoveVector(p63, p64, p65) -- name: calculateRawMoveVector
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_62
	local v66 = v_u_6.CurrentCamera
	if not v66 then
		return p65
	end
	local v67 = v66.CFrame
	if v_u_8.VREnabled and p64.RootPart then
		v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
		local v68 = p63:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame()
		if (v66.Focus.Position - v67.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
			v67 = v67 * v68
		else
			v67 = v66.CFrame * (v68.Rotation + v68.Position * v66.HeadScale)
		end
	end
	if p64:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
		local _, _, _, v73, v70, v71, _, _, v72, _, _, v73 = v67:GetComponents()
		if v72 >= 1 or v72 <= -1 then
			v71 = -v70 * math.sign(v72)
		end
		local v74 = v73 * v73 + v71 * v71
		local v75 = math.sqrt(v74)
		local v76 = (v73 * p65.X + v71 * p65.Z) / v75
		local v77 = (v73 * p65.Z - v71 * p65.X) / v75
		return Vector3.new(v76, 0, v77)
	end
	if not v_u_8.VREnabled then
		return v67:VectorToWorldSpace(p65)
	end
	local v78 = p65.X
	local v79 = p65.Z
	local v80 = Vector3.new(v78, 0, v79)
	if v80.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v81 = -v_u_62().Y * 1.3962634015954636
	local v82 = -v80.X
	local v83 = -v80.Z
	local v84 = math.atan2(v82, v83)
	local _, v85, _ = v67:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
	local v86 = v84 + v85
	return CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(v81, v86, 0).LookVector
end
function v_u_1.OnRenderStepped(p87, p88) -- name: OnRenderStepped
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_2
	if p87.activeController and (p87.activeController.enabled and p87.humanoid) then
		local v89 = p87.activeController:GetMoveVector()
		local v90 = p87.activeController:IsMoveVectorCameraRelative()
		local v91 = p87:GetClickToMoveController()
		if p87.activeController == v91 then
			v91:OnRenderStepped(p88)
		elseif v89.magnitude > 0 then
			v91:CleanupPath()
		else
			v91:OnRenderStepped(p88)
			v89 = v91:GetMoveVector()
			v90 = v91:IsMoveVectorCameraRelative()
		end
		if p87.vehicleController then
			local v92
			v89, v92 = p87.vehicleController:Update(v89, v90, p87.activeControlModule == v_u_10)
		end
		if v90 then
			v89 = p87:calculateRawMoveVector(p87.humanoid, v89)
		end
		p87.inputMoveVector = v89
		if v_u_8.VREnabled then
			v89 = p87:updateVRMoveVector(v89)
		end
		p87.moveFunction(v_u_2.LocalPlayer, v89, false)
		local v93 = p87.humanoid
		local v94 = not p87.activeController:GetIsJumping() and p87.touchJumpController
		if v94 then
			v94 = p87.touchJumpController:GetIsJumping()
		end
		v93.Jump = v94
	end
end
function v_u_1.updateVRMoveVector(p95, p96) -- name: updateVRMoveVector
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v97 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v98 = (v97.Focus.Position - v97.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 5
	if p96.Magnitude ~= 0 or (not v98 or (not v_u_8.AvatarGestures or (not p95.humanoid or p95.humanoid.Sit))) then
		return p96
	end
	local v99 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
	local v100 = v99.Rotation + v99.Position * v97.HeadScale
	local v101 = -0.7 * p95.humanoid.RootPart.Size.Y / 2
	local v102 = (v97.CFrame * v100 * CFrame.new(0, v101, 0)).Position - p95.humanoid.RootPart.CFrame.Position
	local v103 = v102.x
	local v104 = v102.z
	return Vector3.new(v103, 0, v104)
end

	local v32 = p30:GetLocalHumanoid()
	local v33 = (v32.Torso.Position - p31).magnitude / v32.WalkSpeed
	timeReachedLastPoint = tick()
	expectedTimeToNextPoint = v33
	v_u_14:Fire("targetPoint", p31)
end
function v_u_17.StopFollowingPath(p34) -- name: StopFollowingPath
	currentPath = nil
	currentPoints = nil
	currentPointIdx = 0
	moving = false
	p34.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end
function v_u_17.TryComputePath(_, p35, p36) -- name: TryComputePath
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v37 = nil
	local v38 = 0
	while not v37 and v38 < 5 do
		v37 = v_u_5:ComputeSmoothPathAsync(p35, p36, 200)
		v38 = v38 + 1
		if v37.Status == Enum.PathStatus.ClosestNoPath or v37.Status == Enum.PathStatus.ClosestOutOfRange then
			return nil
		end
		if v37 and v37.Status == Enum.PathStatus.FailStartNotEmpty then
			p35 = p35 + (p36 - p35).Unit
			v37 = nil
		end
		if v37 and v37.Status == Enum.PathStatus.FailFinishNotEmpty then
			p36 = p36 + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			v37 = nil
		end
	end
	return v37
end
function v_u_17.OnNavigationRequest(p39, p40, _) -- name: OnNavigationRequest
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10
	local v41 = p40.Position
	local v42 = p39.currentDestination
	local v43 = v41.x
	local v44
	if v43 == v43 and v43 ~= (1 / 0) then
		v44 = v43 ~= (-1 / 0)
	else
		v44 = false
	end
	if v44 then
		local v45 = v41.y
		if v45 == v45 and v45 ~= (1 / 0) then
			v44 = v45 ~= (-1 / 0)
		else
			v44 = false
		end
		if v44 then
			local v46 = v41.z
			if v46 == v46 and v46 ~= (1 / 0) then
				v44 = v46 ~= (-1 / 0)
			else
				v44 = false
			end
		end
	end
	if v44 then
		p39.currentDestination = v41
		local v47 = p39:GetLocalHumanoid()
		if v47 and v47.Torso then
			local v48 = v47.Torso.Position
			if (p39.currentDestination - v48).magnitude < 12 then
				p39:GoToPoint(p39.currentDestination)
			elseif v42 and (p39.currentDestination - v42).magnitude <= 4 then
				if moving then
					p39.currentPoints[#currentPoints] = p39.currentDestination
					return
				end
				p39:GoToPoint(p39.currentDestination)
			else
				local v49 = p39:TryComputePath(v48, p39.currentDestination)
				if v49 then
					p39:StartFollowingPath(v49)
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(p39.currentPoints)
						v_u_10.renderPath()
						return
					end
				else
					p39:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_17.OnJumpAction(p50, _, p51, _) -- name: OnJumpAction
	if p51 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		p50.isJumping = true

	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end
function v_u_17.BindJumpAction(p_u_52, p53) -- name: BindJumpAction

function v_u_17.ControlCharacterGamepad(p54, _, p55, p56) -- name: ControlCharacterGamepad
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_14
	if p56.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 then
		if p55 ~= Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
			if p55 == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				p54.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				if p54:ShouldUseNavigationLaser() then
					p54:BindJumpAction(false)
					p54:SetLaserPointerMode("Navigation")
				end
				if p54.moveLatch then
					p54.moveLatch = false
					v_u_14:Fire("offtrack")
				end
			else
				p54:StopFollowingPath()
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
				end
				if p54:ShouldUseNavigationLaser() then
					p54:BindJumpAction(true)
					p54:SetLaserPointerMode("Hidden")
				end
				if p56.Position.magnitude > 0.22 then
					local v57 = p56.Position.X
					local v58 = -p56.Position.Y
					p54.moveVector = Vector3.new(v57, 0, v58)
					if p54.moveVector.magnitude > 0 then
						local v59 = p54.moveVector.unit
						local v60 = p56.Position.magnitude
						p54.moveVector = v59 * math.min(1, v60)
					end
					p54.moveLatch = true
				end
			end
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
		p54.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_17.OnHeartbeat(p61, p62) -- name: OnHeartbeat
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_14
	local v63 = p61.moveVector
	local v64 = p61:GetLocalHumanoid()
	if v64 and v64.Torso then
		if p61.moving and p61.currentPoints then
			local v65 = v64.Torso.Position
			local v66 = (currentPoints[1] - v65) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			local v67 = v66.magnitude
			local v68 = v66 / v67
			if v67 < 1 then
				local v69 = currentPoints[1]
				local v70 = 0
				for v71, v72 in pairs(currentPoints) do
					if v71 ~= 1 then
						v70 = v70 + (v72 - v69).magnitude / v64.WalkSpeed
						v69 = v72
					end
				end
				table.remove(currentPoints, 1)
				currentPointIdx = currentPointIdx + 1
				if #currentPoints == 0 then
					p61:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					return
				end
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(currentPoints)
					v_u_10.renderPath()
				end
				expectedTimeToNextPoint = (currentPoints[1] - v65).magnitude / v64.WalkSpeed
				timeReachedLastPoint = tick()
			else
				if v_u_13 then
					v_u_12.FilterDescendantsInstances = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v73 = workspace:Raycast(v65 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v68 * 3, v_u_12)
					if v73 then
						local v74 = workspace:Raycast(v73.Position + v68 * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(-0, -100, -0), v_u_12).Position.Y - v65.Y
						if v74 < 6 and v74 > -2 then
							v64.Jump = true
						end
					end
				else
					local v75 = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v76 = Ray.new(v65 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v68 * 3)
					local v77, v78, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v76, v75)
					if v77 then
						local v79 = Ray.new(v78 + v68 * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(-0, -100, -0))
						local _, v80, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v79, v75)
						local v81 = v80.Y - v65.Y
						if v81 < 6 and v81 > -2 then
							v64.Jump = true
						end
					end
				end
				if tick() - timeReachedLastPoint > expectedTimeToNextPoint + 2 then
					p61:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					v_u_14:Fire("offtrack")
				end
				v63 = p61.moveVector:Lerp(v68, p62 * 10)
			end
		end
		local v82 = v63.x
		local v83
		if v82 == v82 and v82 ~= (1 / 0) then
			v83 = v82 ~= (-1 / 0)
		else
			v83 = false
		end
		if v83 then
			local v84 = v63.y
			if v84 == v84 and v84 ~= (1 / 0) then
				v83 = v84 ~= (-1 / 0)
			else
				v83 = false
			end
			if v83 then
				local v85 = v63.z
				if v85 == v85 and v85 ~= (1 / 0) then
					v83 = v85 ~= (-1 / 0)
				else
					v83 = false
				end
			end
		end
		if v83 then
			p61.moveVector = v63
		end
	end
end
function v_u_17.OnUserCFrameEnabled(p86) -- name: OnUserCFrameEnabled

function v_u_17.Enable(p_u_87, p88) -- name: Enable
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	p_u_87.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	p_u_87.isJumping = false

		p_u_87.navigationRequestedConn = v_u_1.NavigationRequested:Connect(function(p89, p90)

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_87
			p_u_87:OnUserCFrameEnabled()
		end)
		p_u_87:OnUserCFrameEnabled()

		v_u_1:SetTouchpadMode(Enum.VRTouchpad.Right, Enum.VRTouchpadMode.ABXY)

	else

		end
		if p_u_87.heartbeatConn then

			p_u_87.heartbeatConn = nil
		end
		if p_u_87.userCFrameEnabledConn then
			p_u_87.userCFrameEnabledConn:Disconnect()
			p_u_87.userCFrameEnabledConn = nil
		end
		p_u_87.enabled = false
	end
end

function v_u_15.ApplyCopyOutfit(_, p129, p130) -- name: ApplyCopyOutfit

	p130:ScaleTo(1)

		v136.Head.Hat:Destroy()

			if v137:IsA("Weld") or v137:IsA("Motor6D") then

				if table.find(v131, v137.Part1.Name) then

			end

function v_u_15.ColorSeqLerpVec(_, p_u_178, p_u_179, p_u_180, p181) -- name: ColorSeqLerpVec
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v_u_182 = p181 or 1
	local function v_u_198(p183, p184) -- name: evalColorSequence
		if p184 == 0 then

			local v187 = p183.Keypoints[#p183.Keypoints].Value.B

		end
		if p184 == 1 then

			local v189 = p183.Keypoints[#p183.Keypoints].Value.G
			local v190 = p183.Keypoints[#p183.Keypoints].Value.B

			local v193 = p183.Keypoints[v191 + 1]

				local v194 = (p184 - v192.Time) / (v193.Time - v192.Time)
				local v195 = (v193.Value.R - v192.Value.R) * v194 + v192.Value.R
				local v196 = (v193.Value.G - v192.Value.G) * v194 + v192.Value.G

		end

	v_u_200 = v_u_2.PreRender:Connect(function(_)

end

function v_u_23.GetMouseTarget(p36, p37, p38) -- name: GetMouseTarget
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_29
	local v39 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v40 = p37 == nil and 300 or p37
	local v41 = v_u_6.Character:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Hanami" and 600 or v40
	if p36.LastInput == "Mobile" or p38 then
		local v42 = RaycastParams.new()
		v42.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		v42.FilterDescendantsInstances = { p38 and workspace.Characters or v_u_6.Character, workspace.Effects, workspace.Logic }
		local v43 = v39.CFrame.LookVector * v41
		local v44 = workspace:Raycast((v39.CFrame + v39.CFrame.UpVector * 1).Position, v43, v42)
		if v44 then
			return v44.Position
		else
			return v39.CFrame.Position + v43
		end
	else
		local v45 = RaycastParams.new()
		v45.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		v45.FilterDescendantsInstances = { p38 and workspace.Characters or v_u_6.Character, workspace.Effects, workspace.Logic }
		local v46 = CFrame.lookAt(v39.CFrame.Position, v_u_29.Hit.Position).LookVector * v41
		local v47 = workspace:Raycast(v39.CFrame.Position, v46, v45)
		if v47 then
			return v47.Position
		else
			return v39.CFrame.Position + v46
		end
	end
end

				local v62 = (Vector2.new(v60.X, v60.Y) - Vector2.new(v53.X, v53.Y)).Magnitude

function v_u_23.UseSetService(p82, p83, ...) -- name: UseSetService

	local v84 = v_u_6.Character

		if p83 == "Ultimate" then
			if v84:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") and v84.CustomChar:GetAttribute("CustomUltData") then
				v_u_1.GetService("CustomService").Awaken:Fire(v_u_26.Custom())
				return
			end
			if v84:GetAttribute("Enchain") then
				local v85 = p82:GetToolService("ItadoriService")
				if v85 then
					v85.UltimateEnchain:Fire(...)
				end
				return
			end
		end
		local v86 = p82:GetToolService(v84:GetAttribute("Moveset") .. "Service")
		if v86 and v86[p83] then
			v86[p83]:Fire(...)
		end
	end
end

				require(v_u_6.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule):GetMoveVector()
			} or false)))

				local v97 = v94[p92]
				local v98 = not v_u_96 and v_u_26[p_u_91.Name]
				if v98 then
					v98 = v_u_26[p_u_91.Name]()

				v97:Fire(p_u_91, v98)

						v_u_96 = v102.ToolDeactivate(v_u_93)

local function v_u_117(p109) -- name: ThrowableFire
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16
	if not p109.Info:FindFirstChild("NoThrowable") then
		local v110 = p109.HumanoidRootPart
		local v111 = 4 * p109:GetScale()
		local v112 = nil
		local v113 = v110.Position + v110.CFrame.LookVector * 3
		if workspace.Map.Destructible:FindFirstChild("Throwable") then
			for _, v114 in workspace.Map.Destructible.Throwable:GetChildren() do
				if v114.PrimaryPart and not (v114:GetAttribute("B") or v114:GetAttribute("Hold")) then
					local v115 = (v113 - v114.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude
					if v111 >= v115 then
						v112 = v114
						v111 = v115
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local v116 = p109.Info:FindFirstChild("Throwable")
		if v112 and not v116 then
			v_u_16.Throwable:Fire(v112)
			return true
		end
		if v116 and (v116.Value and not v116.Value:GetAttribute("Stored")) then
			v_u_16.Throwable:Fire(v116.Value)
			return true
		end
	end
end
function v_u_23.Melee(p118) -- name: Melee
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_117, (copy) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_108, (ref) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_23
	local v119 = v_u_6.Character
	if not v119 then
		return
	end
	if _G.Crow and _G.Crow:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Effects.Crows) then
		_G.Crow:FireServer(true)
		return
	end
	_G.Crow = nil
	if v119.Info:FindFirstChild("Emote") then
		v_u_17.EmoteEnd:Fire()
	end
	if v_u_117(v119) then
		return
	end
	if _G.Settings.AutoUse == false and v_u_28.Value then
		v_u_108 = true
		local v120 = v_u_28.Value:GetAttribute("Key")
		p118:UseKey(v120, "Activated")
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until not v119.Parent or v_u_108 == false
		p118:UseKey(v120, "Deactivated")
		return
	end
	v_u_108 = true
	while true do
		local v121 = v119.Info:FindFirstChild("Item")
		if v121 and v121:FindFirstChild("M1") then
			local v122 = v119.Humanoid.Jump == true
			local v123 = v119.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
			v_u_18.M1:Fire(v123 and "Down" or v122 and "Up", p118:GetTarget())
		else
			local v124 = v119.Humanoid.Jump == true
			local v125 = v119.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
			local v126
			if v119:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Hanami" then
				v126 = v124 and "Up" or v125 and "Down"
			else
				v126 = v125 and "Down" or v124 and "Up"
			end
			if v119.Info:FindFirstChild("DomainClash") then
				p118:GetToolService("DomainService").Activated:Fire(v126)
			elseif v119:FindFirstChild("CustomM1") then
				p118:GetToolService("CustomService").Melee:Fire(v_u_26.Custom())
			else
				p118:UseSetService("Activated", v126, v_u_23:GetTarget())
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.025)
		if not v119.Parent or v_u_108 == false then
			return
		end
	end
end
function v_u_23.Special(p127) -- name: Special
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_26
	local v128 = v_u_6.Character
	if v128 then
		local v129
		if v128 and v128:FindFirstChild("Info") then
			v129 = v128.Info:FindFirstChild("Item") or nil
		else
			v129 = nil
		end
		if v129 and v129:FindFirstChild("M2") then
			v_u_18.M2:Fire()
			return
		elseif v128:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") and v128.CustomChar:GetAttribute("CustomSpecial") then
			p127:GetToolService("CustomService").Special:Fire(v_u_26.Custom())
			return
		else
			local v130 = v128:GetAttribute("Moveset")
			if v130 == "Todo" then
				p127:UseSetService("RightActivated", p127:GetTargetOrProjectile())
				return
			elseif v130 == "Naoya" then
				p127:UseSetService("RightActivated", p127:GetMouseTarget(75), p127:GetTarget())
				return
			elseif v130 == "MeiMei" then
				p127:UseSetService("RightActivated", require(v_u_6.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule):GetMoveVector())
			else
				p127:UseSetService("RightActivated", p127:GetTarget())
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v13.DashRequest(p115) -- name: DashRequest
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_114
	local v116 = v_u_6.Character

			local v124 = v119.Z

					v131 = v116.CustomChar:GetAttribute("CustomChase")
				end

						return
					end
					if v116.Info:FindFirstChild("Stun") then
						return
					end

						return
					end

						if tick() - v_u_14 < 0.4 and not v131 then

						else

							if v138 and v138:FindFirstChild("Dash") then

								return
							elseif v131 then

							else
								v_u_24:UseSetService("Chase", v118.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air)
							end
						end

							return
						elseif v116:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Naoya" or (v116.Info:FindFirstChild("DomainClash") or v133) then

								return
							else

local function v_u_68() -- name: getWalkAnimationName
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_1
	local v65 = (1 - v_u_8.Health / v_u_8.MaxHealth) * 3
	local v66 = game.StarterPlayer.CharacterWalkSpeed * 1.375 - v65
	if v_u_1:GetAttribute("Sprint") and v_u_8.WalkSpeed >= v66 - 1 then
		return "sprint"
	end
	if v_u_1.Info:FindFirstChild("Block") then
		return "walk"
	end

	return v67 > 0.5 and "walkR" or (v67 < -0.5 and "walkL" or "walk")
end

		it("should call unhandled rejection callbacks", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v_u_9 = v_u_1.new(function(_, p8)
				p8(1, 2)
			end)
			local v_u_10 = 0
			local function v14(p11, p12, p13) -- name: callback
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_9
				v_u_10 = v_u_10 + 1
				expect(p11).to.equal(v_u_9)
				expect(p12).to.equal(1)
				expect(p13).to.equal(2)
			end
			local v15 = v_u_1.onUnhandledRejection(v14)
			v_u_6()
			expect(v_u_10).to.equal(1)
			v15()
			v_u_1.new(function(_, p16)
				p16(3, 4)
			end)
			v_u_6()
			expect(v_u_10).to.equal(1)
		end)
	end)

	describe("Promise:cancel", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should mark promises as cancelled and not resolve or reject them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_132 = 0
			local v_u_133 = 0
			local v134 = v_u_1.new(function() end):andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_132
				v_u_132 = v_u_132 + 1
			end):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_133
				v_u_133 = v_u_133 + 1
			end)
			v134:cancel()
			v134:cancel()
			expect(v_u_132).to.equal(0)
			expect(v_u_133).to.equal(1)
			expect(v134:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should call the cancellation hook once", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_135 = 0
			local v137 = v_u_1.new(function(_, _, p136)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_135
				p136(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_135
					v_u_135 = v_u_135 + 1
				end)
			end)
			v137:cancel()
			v137:cancel()
			expect(v_u_135).to.equal(1)
		end)
		it("should propagate cancellations", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v138 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v139 = v138:andThen()
			local v140 = v138:andThen()

			expect(v139:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)

			expect(v139:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)

			expect(v140:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)

		it("should track consumers", function()

	describe("Promise:finally", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should be called upon resolve, reject, or cancel", function()

				p155()

		it("should propagate cancellation downwards", function()

	describe("Promise.fold", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should return the initial value in a promise when the list is empty", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v236 = {}
			local v237 = v_u_1.fold({}, function()
				error("should not be called")
			end, v236)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v237)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v237:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v237:expect()).to.equal(v236)

		it("should accept promises in the list", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v242 = v_u_1.fold({ v_u_1.new(function(p239)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_238
					v_u_238 = p239
				end), 2, 3 }, function(p240, p241)
				return p240 + p241
			end, 0)
			v_u_238(1)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v242)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v242:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v242:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should always return a promise even if the list or reducer don\'t use them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

					return v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p243 + p244)
				else
					return p243 + p244
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v246)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v246:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(2)
			expect(v246:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v246:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should return the first rejected promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v250 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p247, p248, p249)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p249 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.reject("foo")
				else
					return p247 + p248
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v250)).to.equal(true)

		it("should return the first canceled promise", function()

					return p254 + p255
				end

				end

			expect(v_u_1.is(v257)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v257:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_253:cancel()

		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.race", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1

	end)
	describe("Promise.promisify", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should wrap functions", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

		it("should catch errors after a yield", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_273 = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			local v274 = v_u_1.promisify(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_273
				v_u_273.Event:Wait()
				error("errortext")
			end)()
			expect(v274:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_273:Fire()
			expect(v274:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			local v275 = expect
			local v276 = v274._values[1]

		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.tap", function()

	describe("Promise.some", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v304 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(1), v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.resolve(2) }, 2)
			expect(v304:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)

		it("should error if the goal can\'t be reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v_u_305 = nil
			local v307 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(), v_u_1.new(function(_, p306)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_305
					v_u_305 = p306
				end) }, 2)
			expect(v307:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_305("foo")
			expect(v307:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)

		it("should cancel pending Promises once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_308 = nil
			local v309 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v311 = v_u_1.new(function(p310)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_308
				v_u_308 = p310
			end)
			local v312 = v_u_1.some({ v309, v311, v_u_1.resolve() }, 2)
			expect(v312:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_308()
			expect(v312:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
		end)
		it("should error if passed a non-number", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			expect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_1.some({}, "non-number")
			end).to.throw()
		end)
		it("should return an empty array if amount is 0", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

	describe("Promise.each", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should iterate", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v340, v341 = v_u_1.each({
				"foo",
				"bar",
				"baz",
				"qux"
			}, function(...)
				return { ... }
			end):_unwrap()
			expect(v340).to.equal(true)
			expect(v341[1][1]).to.equal("foo")
			expect(v341[1][2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v341[2][1]).to.equal("bar")
			expect(v341[2][2]).to.equal(2)
			expect(v341[3][1]).to.equal("baz")
			expect(v341[3][2]).to.equal(3)
			expect(v341[4][1]).to.equal("qux")
			expect(v341[4][2]).to.equal(4)
		end)
		it("should iterate serially", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_342 = {}
			local v_u_343 = {}
			local v349 = v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(p_u_344, p345)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_343, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_342
				v_u_343[p345] = (v_u_343[p345] or 0) + 1
				return v_u_1.new(function(p_u_346)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_342, (copy) p_u_344
					local v347 = v_u_342
					local function v348()
						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_346, (ref) p_u_344
						p_u_346(p_u_344:upper())
					end
					table.insert(v347, v348)
				end)
			end)
			expect(v349:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(#v_u_342).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[2]).to.never.be.ok()
			table.remove(v_u_342, 1)()
			expect(v349:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(#v_u_342).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[3]).to.never.be.ok()
			table.remove(v_u_342, 1)()
			expect(v349:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v_u_343[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[3]).to.equal(1)
			table.remove(v_u_342, 1)()
			expect(v349:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			local v350 = expect
			local v351 = v349._values[1]
			v350((type(v351))).to.equal("table")
			local v352 = expect
			local v353 = v349._values[2]
			v352((type(v353))).to.equal("nil")
			local v354 = v349._values[1]
			expect(v354[1]).to.equal("FOO")
			expect(v354[2]).to.equal("BAR")
			expect(v354[3]).to.equal("BAZ")
		end)
		it("should reject with the value if the predicate promise rejects", function()

		it("should allow Promises to be in the list and wait when it gets to them", function()

		it("should stop iteration if Promise.each is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_366 = {}
			local v368 = v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(_, p367)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_366, (ref) v_u_1

		it("should cancel the Promise returned from the predicate if Promise.each is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(_, _)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_369, (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_369 = v_u_1.new(function() end)

	describe("Promise.retry", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should retry N times", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v373 = v_u_1.retry(function(p372)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_371, (ref) v_u_1

					return v_u_1.resolve("ok")

					return v_u_1.reject("fail")
				end

		end)
		it("should reject if threshold is exceeded", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			end, 5)
			expect(v374:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)

		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.retryWithDelay", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v_u_375 = 0

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_375, (ref) v_u_1

			expect(v377._values[1]).to.equal("ok")
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.fromEvent", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should convert a Promise into an event", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

function v_u_3._startTimerNoDrift(p_u_26) -- name: _startTimerNoDrift

	assert(v27, "Interval must be greater than 0 when AllowDrift is set to false")
	local v_u_28 = p_u_26.TimeFunction
	local v_u_29 = 1

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_31, (ref) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_30, (copy) p_u_26
		local v32 = v_u_28()

			v_u_29 = v_u_29 + 1

	end)
end

		return

		p33:_startTimer()
	else
		p33:_startTimerNoDrift()

		p34:Start()
	end
end

	end
end

function v_u_1.UpdateShake(p16, p17) -- name: UpdateShake
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v18 = p16.tick
	local v19 = p16.currentFadeTime
	local v20 = v_u_2(v_u_3(v18, 0) * 0.5, v_u_3(0, v18) * 0.5, v_u_3(v18, v18) * 0.5)
	if p16.fadeInDuration > 0 and p16.sustain then
		if v19 < 1 then
			v19 = v19 + p17 / p16.fadeInDuration
		elseif p16.fadeOutDuration > 0 then
			p16.sustain = false
		end
	end
	if not p16.sustain then

	end

		p16.tick = v18 + p17 * p16.Roughness * p16.roughMod
	else
		p16.tick = v18 + p17 * p16.Roughness * p16.roughMod * v19

end

================================================================================
help | Type: ModuleScript | Method: decompile
Location: ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Cmdr.Server commands.help
================================================================================

return {
	["Name"] = "help",
	["Description"] = "Displays a list of all commands, or inspects one command.",
	["Group"] = "Help",
	["Args"] = nil,
	["ClientRun"] = nil,
	["Args"] = {
		{
			["Type"] = "command",
			["Name"] = "Command",
			["Description"] = "The command to view information on",
			["Optional"] = true
		}
	},
	["ClientRun"] = function(p1, p2) -- name: ClientRun
		if p2 then
			local v3 = p1.Cmdr.Registry:GetCommand(p2)
			p1:Reply(("Command: %*"):format(v3.Name), Color3.fromRGB(230, 126, 34))
			if v3.Aliases and #v3.Aliases > 0 then
				p1:Reply(("Aliases: %*"):format((table.concat(v3.Aliases, ", "))), Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230))
			end
			p1:Reply(v3.Description, Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230))
			for v4, v5 in ipairs(v3.Args) do
				p1:Reply((("#%* %*%*: %* - %*"):format(v4, v5.Name, v5.Optional == true and "?" or "", v5.Type, v5.Description)))
			end
		else
			p1:Reply("Argument Shorthands\n-------------------\n.   Me/Self\n*   All/Everyone\n**  Others\n?   Random\n?N  List of N random values\n")
			p1:Reply("Tips\n----\n\226\128\162 Utilize the Tab key to automatically complete commands\n\226\128\162 Easily select and copy command output\n")
			local v6 = p1.Cmdr.Registry:GetCommands()
			table.sort(v6, function(p7, p8)
				if p7.Group and p8.Group then
					return p7.Group < p8.Group
				else
					return p7.Group
				end
			end)
			local v9 = nil
			for _, v10 in ipairs(v6) do
				v10.Group = v10.Group or "No Group"
				if v9 ~= v10.Group then
					p1:Reply((("\n%*\n%*"):format(v10.Group, (string.rep("-", #v10.Group)))))
					v9 = v10.Group
				end
				local v11
				if v10.Description then
					v11 = ("%* - %*"):format(v10.Name, v10.Description)
				else
					v11 = v10.Name
				end
				p1:Reply(v11)
			end
		end
		return ""
	end
}

teleportServer | Type: ModuleScript | Method: decompile
Location: ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Cmdr.Server commands.Admin.teleportServer
================================================================================

return function(_, p1, p2)
	local v3 = nil
	if typeof(p2) == "Instance" then
		if not (p2.Character and p2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
			return "Target player has no character."
		end
		v3 = p2.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
	elseif typeof(p2) == "Vector3" then
		v3 = CFrame.new(p2)
	end
	for _, v4 in ipairs(p1) do
		if v4.Character and v4.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			v4.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = v3
		end
	end
	return ("Teleported %d players."):format(#p1)
end

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_2
		return v_u_1:GetPlayerPlaceInstanceAsync(p_u_2)
	end)
	if not v5 or v6 and #v6 > 0 then

		end

		return v7 .. " " .. v8
	end

	end
	if v4 == "JobId" then

================================================================================
bind | Type: ModuleScript | Method: decompile
Location: ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Cmdr.Server commands.Utility.bind
================================================================================

local v_u_1 = game:GetService("UserInputService")
return {
	["Name"] = "bind",
	["Aliases"] = nil,
	["Description"] = "Binds a command string to a key or mouse input.",
	["Group"] = "DefaultUtil",
	["Args"] = nil,
	["ClientRun"] = nil,
	["Aliases"] = {},
	["Args"] = {
		{
			["Type"] = "userInput ! bindableResource @ player",
			["Name"] = "Input",
			["Description"] = "The key or input type you\'d like to bind the command to."
		},
		{
			["Type"] = "command",
			["Name"] = "Command",
			["Description"] = "The command you want to run on this input"
		},
		{
			["Type"] = "string",
			["Name"] = "Arguments",
			["Description"] = "The arguments for the command",
			["Default"] = ""
		}
	},
	["ClientRun"] = function(p_u_2, p_u_3, p4, p5) -- name: ClientRun
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		local v6 = p_u_2:GetStore("CMDR_Binds")
		local v_u_7 = p4 .. " " .. p5
		if v6[p_u_3] then
			v6[p_u_3]:Disconnect()
		end
		local v8 = p_u_2:GetArgument(1).Type.Name
		if v8 == "userInput" then
			v6[p_u_3] = v_u_1.InputBegan:Connect(function(p9, p10)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_3, (copy) p_u_2, (ref) v_u_7
				if not p10 then
					if p9.UserInputType == p_u_3 or p9.KeyCode == p_u_3 then
						p_u_2:Reply(p_u_2.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(p_u_2.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(p_u_2.Dispatcher, v_u_7)))
					end
				end
			end)
		else
			if v8 == "bindableResource" then
				return "Unimplemented..."
			end
			if v8 == "player" then
				v6[p_u_3] = p_u_3.Chatted:Connect(function(p11)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_2, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) p_u_3
					local v12 = p_u_2.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(p_u_2.Dispatcher, p_u_2.Cmdr.Util.SubstituteArgs(v_u_7, { p11 }))
					p_u_2:Reply(("%s $ %s : %s"):format(p_u_3.Name, v12, p_u_2.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(v12)), Color3.fromRGB(244, 92, 66))
				end)
			end
		end
		return "Bound command to input."
	end
}

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	local v12 = true
	local v13
	if p9:sub(1, 1) == "$" then
		p9 = p9:sub(2)
		v13 = true
	else
		v13 = false
	end
	if p9:sub(1, 1) == "." then
		p9 = p9:sub(2)
		v12 = false

			v15 = "global"
		else
			local v16 = p8.Executor.UserId
			v15 = tostring(v16)
		end
		local v17 = v14 .. v15
		if v12 then
			local v18 = v_u_4:GetAsync(v17 .. "_" .. p9) or ""
			return type(v18) == "table" and (table.concat(v18, ",") or "") or v18
		else
			local v19 = p8:GetStore(v17)[p9] or ""
			return type(v19) == "table" and (table.concat(v19, ",") or "") or v19
		end
	end

				p28.StateInfo.IsActivelyResimulating = false
			else

			end

				print("Piercing function returned TRUE to pierce this part.")

			end

			local v85 = {}
			local v86 = false
			local v87 = 0
			while true do
				if v53.Instance:IsA("Terrain") then
					if v54 == Enum.Material.Water then
						p28:Terminate()

				if v53 == nil then
					break
				end
				if v87 >= 100 then
					warn("WARNING: Exceeded maximum pierce test budget for a single ray segment (attempted to test the same segment " .. 100 .. " times!)")

				end
				v87 = v87 + 1

					break
				end
			end

		end
	end
	if p28.StateInfo.DistanceCovered >= p28.RayInfo.MaxDistance then
		p28:Terminate()

function v_u_27._UpdateGeometry(p53, p54, p55, p56, p57, p58, p59) -- name: _UpdateGeometry

			if not v10 then
				v_u_1:MVP_End(v_u_8, true)

		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.MVP_End(_, p12, p13) -- name: MVP_End
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3
	if not p13 then
		local v14 = script.Fade:Clone()
		v14.Parent = v_u_4.PlayerGui

			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 0
		}):Play()

		v_u_2:Create(v14.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1
		}):Play()
	end
	for v15 = #p12, 1, -1 do
		local v16 = p12[v15]
		if v16 then
			table.remove(p12, v15)
			if typeof(v16) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
				v16:Disconnect()

				pcall(v16)
			elseif v16:IsA("AnimationTrack") then
				v16:Stop()
			else
				v16:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	local v17 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	v17.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_270, p_u_271, p_u_272) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner

				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_271, (copy) v_u_274, (copy) v_u_273

			end))
		end
		local function v_u_279() -- name: getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_271
			local v275 = 0
			local v276 = 0
			for _, v277 in p_u_271.Frame:GetChildren() do
				local v278 = string.lower(v277.Name)
				if v278 == "digit" then
					v275 = v275 + v277.AbsoluteSize.X
					v276 = v276 + 1
				elseif (v278 == "prefix" or (v278 == "suffix" or v278 == "comma")) and v277.Text ~= "" then
					v275 = v275 + v277.AbsoluteSize.X
					v276 = v276 + 1
				end
			end
			return v275, v276
		end
		local function v_u_288() -- name: adjustSize
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_279, (ref) p_u_270, (ref) p_u_271, (copy) v_u_273
			local v280, v281 = v_u_279()
			if v281 < 18 then
				p_u_270:setLabel(p_u_271.Value)
			end
			local v282 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X

			end
			local v284 = v_u_273.Parent

				v284 = v284.Parent
			end
			local v285

				v285 = 0
			elseif v284.IconImage.Visible == true then
				v285 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X + v_u_273.Parent.Parent.IconImage.AbsoluteSize.X
			else

function v_u_1.updateKeyText(_, p6, p7) -- name: updateKeyText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v8 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Knit.Knit).GetController("ToolController").LastInput or "Keyboard"
	local v9 = p7:FindFirstChild((v8 == "Xbox" or v8 == "Playstation") and "Gamepad" or v8)
	if v9 then
		if v8 == "Playstation" and v_u_1.KeybindPSNames[v9.KeyCode.Name] then
			p6.Key.Visible = true
			p6.KeyIcon.Visible = false
			p6.Key.Text = v_u_1.KeybindPSNames[v9.KeyCode.Name]
			return
		elseif v_u_1.KeybindNames[v9.KeyCode.Name] then
			p6.Key.Visible = true
			p6.KeyIcon.Visible = false
			p6.Key.Text = v_u_1.KeybindNames[v9.KeyCode.Name]
			return
		elseif v8 == "Playstation" and v_u_1.KeybindPSImages[v9.KeyCode.Name] then
			p6.Key.Visible = false
			p6.KeyIcon.Visible = true
			p6.KeyIcon.Image = v_u_1.KeybindPSImages[v9.KeyCode.Name]
			return
		elseif v_u_1.KeybindImages[v9.KeyCode.Name] then
			p6.Key.Visible = false
			p6.KeyIcon.Visible = true
			p6.KeyIcon.Image = v_u_1.KeybindImages[v9.KeyCode.Name]
			return
		elseif v_u_2:GetImageForKeyCode(v9.KeyCode) == "" then
			p6.Key.Visible = true
			p6.KeyIcon.Visible = false
			p6.Key.Text = v9.KeyCode.Name
		else
			p6.Key.Visible = false
			p6.KeyIcon.Visible = true
			p6.KeyIcon.Image = v_u_2:GetImageForKeyCode(v9.KeyCode)
		end
	else
		return
	end

================================================================================
TextToZee | Type: ModuleScript | Method: decompile
Location: ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Settings.Audio.TTS.TextToZee
================================================================================

local v1 = {}
game:GetService("Debris")
local v_u_2 = game:GetService("RunService")
game:GetService("TweenService")
local v_u_3 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.TTS
function syllable(p4, p5, p6, p7) -- name: syllable
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if p5 then
		if p4 then
			local v8 = (p6.Pitch or 1) * (p7 or 1)
			local v9 = p6.Speed or 1
			local v10 = p6.Volume or 1
			local v11
			if #p4 == 3 then
				v11 = string.sub(p4, 3, 3)
				p4 = string.sub(p4, 1, 2)
			else
				v11 = nil
			end
			local v12 = (script.Voices:FindFirstChild(p6.Voice or "TTZ") or script.Voices.TTZ):FindFirstChild(p4)
			if v12 then
				local v13 = v12.TimeLength == 0 and 0.1 or (v12.TimeLength or 0.1)
				if v11 == "1" then
					v10 = v10 + 0.25
					v9 = v9 + 0.1
					v8 = v8 + 0.05
				elseif v11 == "2" then
					v10 = v10 + 0.1
					v9 = v9 + 0.05
				elseif v11 == "0" then
					v10 = v10 - 0.1
					v9 = v9 - 0.075
				end
				local v_u_14 = v12:Clone()
				local v15 = Instance.new("PitchShiftSoundEffect")
				v15.Octave = v8
				v15.Parent = v_u_14
				v_u_14.SoundGroup = game.SoundService.Voice
				v_u_14.PlaybackSpeed = v_u_14.PlaybackSpeed * v9
				v_u_14.Volume = v_u_14.Volume * v10
				v_u_14.Parent = p5
				v_u_14:Play()
				task.delay(v13, function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
					v_u_14:Destroy()
				end)
				local v16 = tick()
				local v17 = 0
				while v_u_14.PlaybackLoudness >= v17 do
					v17 = v_u_14.PlaybackLoudness
					v_u_2.RenderStepped:Wait()
					if tick() > v16 + v13 or not v_u_14.Parent then
						break
					end
				end
			else
				if p4 == " " then
					task.wait(0.05 / v9)
					return
				end
				if p4 == "." or (p4 == "!" or p4 == "?") then
					task.wait(0.7 / v9)
					return
				end
				if p4 == "," then
					task.wait(0.5 / v9)
					return
				end
				task.wait(0.3 / v9)
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
local v_u_18 = {}
function v1.TTS(p19, p20, p21)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_18
	local v22 = v_u_3:InvokeServer(p19, p21.Accent)
	if not v22 then
		return
	end
	local v23 = tick()
	v_u_18[p20] = v23
	for _, v24 in v22 do
		if v_u_18[p20] ~= v23 then
			break
		end
		for _, v25 in v24 do
			syllable(v25[1], p20, p21, v25[2])
		end
	end
	if v_u_18[p20] == v23 then
		v_u_18[p20] = nil
	end
end
return v1

function v_u_6.LoseFocus(p29, p30) -- name: LoseFocus

	if v_u_7.Visible and not v_u_1.MenuIsOpen then
		v_u_9.TextBox:CaptureFocus()

		p29:AddLine(p29._errorText, Color3.fromRGB(255, 153, 153))
	end
end
function v_u_6.TraverseHistory(p32, p33) -- name: TraverseHistory
	local v34 = p32.Cmdr.Dispatcher:GetHistory()
	if p32.HistoryState == nil then
		p32.HistoryState = {
			["Position"] = #v34 + 1,
			["InitialText"] = p32:GetEntryText()
		}
	end
	local v35 = p32.HistoryState
	local v36 = p32.HistoryState.Position + p33
	local v37 = #v34 + 1
	v35.Position = math.clamp(v36, 1, v37)
	p32:SetEntryText(p32.HistoryState.Position == #v34 + 1 and p32.HistoryState.InitialText or v34[p32.HistoryState.Position])
end

	p38.HistoryState = nil

		p39:TraverseHistory(p40)
	end
end
local v_u_41 = 0
local v_u_42 = 0
function v_u_6.BeginInput(p43, p44, p45) -- name: BeginInput
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_41, (ref) v_u_42, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_7
	if v_u_1.MenuIsOpen then
		p43:Hide()
	end
	if p45 and p43:IsVisible() == false then
		return
	elseif p43.Cmdr.ActivationKeys[p44.KeyCode] then
		if p43.Cmdr.MashToEnable and not p43.Cmdr.Enabled then
			if tick() - v_u_41 < 1 then
				if v_u_42 >= 5 then
					return p43.Cmdr:SetEnabled(true)
				end
				v_u_42 = v_u_42 + 1
			else
				v_u_42 = 1
			end
			v_u_41 = tick()
		elseif p43.Cmdr.Enabled then
			p43:SetVisible(not p43:IsVisible())
			wait()
			p43:SetEntryText("")
			if v_u_1.MenuIsOpen then
				p43:Hide()
			end
		end
	elseif p43.Cmdr.Enabled == false or not p43:IsVisible() then
		if p43:IsVisible() then
			p43:Hide()
		end
	elseif p43.Cmdr.HideOnLostFocus and table.find(v_u_5, p44.UserInputType) then
		local v46 = p44.Position
		local v47 = v_u_7.AbsolutePosition
		local v48 = v_u_7.AbsoluteSize
		if v46.X < v47.X or (v46.X > v47.X + v48.X or (v46.Y < v47.Y or v46.Y > v47.Y + v48.Y)) then
			p43:Hide()
			return
		end
	else
		if p44.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			p43:SelectVertical(1)
			return
		end
		if p44.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			p43:SelectVertical(-1)
			return
		end
		if p44.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return then
			wait()
			p43:SetEntryText(p43:GetEntryText():gsub("\n", ""):gsub("\r", ""))
			return
		end
		if p44.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
			local v49 = p43.AutoComplete:GetSelectedItem()
			local v50 = p43:GetEntryText()
			if v49 and not (v50:sub(#v50, #v50):match("%s") and p43.AutoComplete.LastItem) then
				local v51 = v49[2]
				local v52 = p43.AutoComplete.Command
				local v53, v54
				if v52 then
					local v55 = p43.AutoComplete.Arg
					v53 = v52.Alias
					if p43.AutoComplete.NumArgs == #v52.ArgumentDefinitions then
						v54 = false
					else
						v54 = p43.AutoComplete.IsPartial == false
					end
					local v56 = v52.Arguments
					for v57 = 1, #v56 do
						local v58 = v56[v57]
						local v59 = v58.RawSegments
						if v58 == v55 then
							v59[#v59] = v51
						end
						local v60 = v58.Prefix .. table.concat(v59, ",")
						if v60:find(" ") or v60 == "" then
							v60 = ("%q"):format(v60)
						end
						v53 = ("%s %s"):format(v53, v60)
						if v58 == v55 then
							break
						end
					end
				else
					v53 = v51
					v54 = true
				end
				wait()
				p43:SetEntryText(v53 .. (v54 and " " or ""))
			else
				wait()
				p43:SetEntryText(p43:GetEntryText())
			end
		end
		p43:ClearHistoryState()
	end
end
v_u_9.TextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(p61)

	return v_u_6:LoseFocus(p61)
end)
v_u_2.InputBegan:Connect(function(p62, p63)

end)

	v_u_7.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, v_u_7.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y)
	if v_u_9.TextBox.Text:match("\t") then
		v_u_9.TextBox.Text = v_u_9.TextBox.Text:gsub("\t", "")
	elseif v_u_6.OnTextChanged then
		return v_u_6.OnTextChanged(v_u_9.TextBox.Text)
	end
end)

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	task.defer(v_u_6.UpdateWindowHeight)
end)
return v_u_6

================================================================================
Watch | Type: ModuleScript | Method: decompile
Location: ReplicatedStorage.CmdrClient.Commands.Watch
================================================================================

return {
	["Name"] = "watch",
	["Description"] = "Watches a player.",
	["Group"] = nil,
	["Args"] = nil,
	["ClientRun"] = nil,
	["Group"] = {
		"Owner",
		"Developer",
		"HeadMod",
		"Mod",
		"Tester",
		"TesterPublic",
		"Contrib",
		"Youtuber"
	},
	["Args"] = {
		{
			["Type"] = "player",
			["Name"] = "Player"
		}
	},
	["ClientRun"] = function(_, p1) -- name: ClientRun
		local v2 = p1.Character
		if not v2 then
			return "Player has no character."
		end
		local v3 = v2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not v3 then
			return "Player has no humanoid."
		end
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = v3
		return "Watching player."
	end
}

	table.insert(v3, v4)

local function v_u_14(p6) -- name: stringToSecondDuration
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_2
	if p6 == nil or p6 == "" then
		return nil
	else
		local v7 = tonumber(p6)
		if v7 and v7 == 0 then
			return 0, 0, true
		else
			local v8 = p6:gsub("-?%d+%a+", ""):match("-?%d+")
			if v8 then
				return nil, tonumber(v8), true
			else
				local v9 = nil
				local v10 = nil
				for v11 in p6:gmatch("-?%d+%a+") do
					local v12
					v10, v12 = v11:match("(-?%d+)(%a+)")
					local v13 = v_u_5(v12)
					if #v13 == 0 then
						return nil, tonumber(v10)
					end
					v9 = (v9 == nil and 0 or v9) + (v12:lower() == "m" and 60 or v_u_2[v13[1]]) * tonumber(v10)
				end
				if v9 == nil then
					return nil
				else
					return v9, tonumber(v10)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
local function v_u_23(p15, p16, p17, p18) -- name: mapUnits
	local v19 = p18 or 1
	local v20 = {}
	for v21, v22 in pairs(p15) do
		if p17 == 1 then
			v20[v21] = p16 .. v22:sub(v19, #v22 - 1)
		else
			v20[v21] = p16 .. v22:sub(v19)
		end
	end
	return v20
end

		return p25 ~= nil
	end,
	["Autocomplete"] = function(p26, p27, p28, p29, p30) -- name: Autocomplete
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_23
		local v31 = {}
		if p29 or p30 then
			if p29 == true then
				p30 = v_u_5("") or p30
			end
			if p29 == true then
				return v_u_23(p30, p26, p28)
			else
				return v_u_23(p30, p26, p26:match("^.*(%a+)$"):len() + 1)
			end
		else
			if p27 ~= nil then
				local v32 = p26:match("^.*-?%d+(%a+)%s?$")
				v31 = v_u_23(v_u_5(v32), p26, p28, #v32 + 1)
				table.sort(v31)

		end

function v_u_5.Transform(p19) -- name: Transform
